Maduo Catalog Knowledge Graph — GraphRAG Output (redesigned prompt)

Full entity–relationship graph automatically extracted by GraphRAG from the 2021 Maduo Mw7.4 catalog, using the text-grounded-only prompt design (Section 5), no hand-designed schema.

Note: GraphRAG's own 2D embedding placed 12,328 of the entities; the remaining 611 (mostly isolated small clusters with no path to the main component) have no GraphRAG-computed position and are shown at reduced opacity, laid out component-by-component in the gallery area to avoid misrepresenting them as part of the same embedding space.
